therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reduction of inflammatory response and prevention of anti-TNF antibody formation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Pediatric Crohn's disease patients initiating anti-TNF therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percent of participants experiencing treatment failure

biomarker_changes: 28.5% vs 40% positive anti-TNF antibody formation (RR 0.71, 95% CI 0.49-1.04, p=0.08)
results.dose_information: Weekly oral methotrexate: 15 mg for children ≥40kg, 12.5 mg for children 30 to <40 kg, and 10 mg for children 20 to <30 kg, with folic acid 1 mg daily and ondansetron 4mg twice weekly for nausea prevention

context.duration: Up to 3 years treatment and follow-up
